title: Local top-degree Koszul coefficient map is bijective on stalks
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] with kernel ideal sheaf I [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let V⊆Z, n∈ℕ, z∈V, and let U⊆Y be affine containing i(z), with I(U) generated by a Koszul-regular sequence f:Fin n→Γ(Y,U) [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Put B=i_*O_Z, F=H^n(RHom_Y(B,O_Y)), G=H^n(RHom_Y(B,B)) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The actual canonical coefficient map O_Y→B induces φ:i*F→i*G [def-pc-module-pullback]. Its restriction to V has bijective stalk linear map at z [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. No global regularity or rank hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: On the affine chart A=Γ(Y,U), I=ker(i)(U), B=A/I, take the actual finite free Koszul projective resolution of B and its quotient augmentation. Sheafify using the closed immersion quotient-spectrum identification. The exterior basis makes this a bounded finite free complex.

Restrict derived internal Hom and use the bounded finite free model to identify its natural coefficient morphisms with those of the sheafified Hom complex. The common K-injective model compares the supplied derived universe.

The degree-n term of Hom(K,A) is the top exterior dual, a free module of rank one. Its outgoing term is zero and its incoming image is I times that term: the differential is the row of f up to signs. The complex Hom(K,B) has all differentials zero, and its degree-n term is that same module modulo I. Reduction of coefficients therefore induces an isomorphism in degree n. At n=0, I=0 and this is identity. The point over U excludes the empty preimage.

Exact associated-module sheafification transports the cohomology comparison. Both top cohomology modules are B-modules; tensoring with B leaves them unchanged. Restrict to V and take the stalk at z. Naturality identifies this map with the specified map obtained from the adjunction unit; thus its stalk map is bijective.

proof_origin.note: The cited Koszul calculation expanded for the precise derived sheaf and tensor-pullback interface; no arbitrary object chosen from existence.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_ext_coefficient_stalk_iso
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (V : Z.Opens) (n : ℕ) (z : V.toScheme)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hzU : i z.1 ∈ U.1) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    Function.Bijective
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
        (koszulScalarExtCoefficientMap i n)).stalkLinearMap z)
